title: Divide with remainder
hints: Named results `q, r int, err error` are already variables set to `0`, `0` and `nil`. You only assign the ones you need.
Handle the failure first: `if b == 0 { err = errors.New("division by zero"); return }`. Don't forget `import "errors"`.
After the check, assign both results at once with `q, r = a/b, a%b` and finish with a naked `return`.
